# Project overview

This project uses behavioural data from the SSRA and Human
Behaviour Study, available through Zenodo.

The project explores a research question developed by the group
using appropriate statistical analyses and visualisations.

# Research question

What is the effect of emotional valence on impulsivity at different levels of trait anxiety?

The project investigates whether the emotional valence of stimuli is associated with impulsivity during inhibition tasks, and whether this relationship varies according to individual differences in trait anxiety.
